participant_id.Description: BIDS label = patient ID of the release (L1-L3: left-hemisphere implants; R4-R6: right-hemisphere implants)

implant_hemisphere.Description: Hemisphere of the implant (release file names)

age.Description: Age in years from Table 1 of Merrick et al. 2022 for L1-L3. Table 1 labels the right-hemisphere patients R1-R3 (ages 26, 32, 34; all right-handed) while the release uses R4-R6; the correspondence is not stated, so R4-R6 are n/a.

sex.Description: Not given per patient (paper: two of six patients female)

handedness.Description: Handedness from Table 1 (L1-L3); R4-R6 n/a for the reason given under age

group.Description: Patient with intractable epilepsy implanted for clinical monitoring

recording_site.Description: Hospital, inferred from the release session codes (EC = UCSF, IR = UCI, CP = CPMC) and the stored analog-channel rates; matches the paper's 2 patients per site
